claim_boundary: Matched-start CO2 runs are physical evidence for parameterization/validation/testing.
Unexpected-response anomaly intervals are replay-labelled and never overwrite physical rows.
Duty order is balanced across repetitions and enforced by the source runner.
A resumed repetition is accepted only after the same completeness and protocol checks as a new repetition.
A one-repetition confirmatory profile is held out from fitting and threshold selection.

opening_recovery.prerun_record: rq2_prerun_purge.csv, excluded from the comparison record
opening_recovery.recorded_sequence: Fan-off rise from the pre-run CO2 until the stable 950 ppm start, then the selected duty order with the usual qualification between duties.
